title: Character from the perpendicular subspace
statement: Let $H$ be a subspace of the binary cube $ br^n$ over the field with two elements, and let $f$ map the binary cube to the signs $\{\pm1\}$. Then $f$ is a character arising from the perpendicular subspace of $H$ precisely when there is some $\eta$ in that perpendicular subspace such that, for every $z$, $f(z)$ is the sign encoding of the binary dot product of $\eta$ and $z$.
